unit.description:
The unit to use in unit formatting.
Valid units:
https://tc39.es/proposal-unified-intl-numberformat/section6/locales-currencies-tz_proposed_out.html#sec-issanctionedsimpleunitidentifier

unitDisplay.description: The unit formatting style to use in unit formatting.

currency.description:
The currency to use in currency formatting. Possible values are the ISO 4217 currency codes.
If {@link style} is "currency", the currency field must be provided.

currencyDisplay.description:
How to display the currency in currency formatting.
  - "symbol" to use a localized currency symbol such as €,
  - "code" to use the ISO currency code
  - "name" to use a localized currency name such as "dollar"

minimumIntegerDigits.description:
The minimum number of integer digits to use. Possible values are from 1 to 21.

@example
  1) minimumIntegerDigits = 0
       123 => 123
  2) minimumIntegerDigits = 5
       123 => 00123

minimumSignificantDigits.description: The minimum number of significant digits to use. Possible values are from 1 to 21.

maximumSignificantDigits.description: The maximum number of significant digits to use. Possible values are from 1 to 21.

notation.description: The formatting that should be displayed for the number.

compactDisplay.description: The compact formatting style to use when {@link notation} is `compact`.

title:
Use to specify format of NUMBER.
Type representation of [Intl.NumberFormat](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/NumberFormat) options.
